messages:
hana: Quick report: canary publish of @redwood/js-sdk is causing editor/typechecker weirdness + Cloudflare Pages Functions builds to fail. Looks like a subtle exports + typesVersions interaction. Tagging @pete (packaging) and @amar (runtimes).

hana: Repro (minimal):
1) create a fresh app with TS
2) yarn add @redwood/js-sdk@canary
3) import {createClient} from '@redwood/js-sdk' -> VSCode shows red squiggles; cf-pages build fails with resolver error.

hana: Current package.json exports snippet shipped in canary:
```json
{
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs",
      "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
    },
    "./client": "./dist/esm/client.mjs",
    "./server": "./dist/cjs/server.cjs",
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  }
}
```

hana: Cloudflare build error:
```
Error: Could not resolve "@redwood/js-sdk" from /workspace/src/pages/index.tsx
```

pete: Hmm. Two likely causes: (1) Cloudflare and some bundlers prefer ".js" ESM paths, not ".mjs"; (2) TypeScript/tsserver will ignore root "types" unless types are mapped on the exact exported subpath the editor requests. When you have exports with subpaths, editors try to resolve types per subpath.

amar: I reproduced with Pages Functions. The bundler in their pipeline calls the resolver in a way that doesn't honor the `import` conditional when a subpath import is requested (e.g., '@redwood/js-sdk/client'). Because we exported './client' as a string (no conditional) pointing to .mjs, it fails on their resolver.

pete: Practical patch: publish a 0.6.x that does the following: (a) provide .js equivalents for ESM and CJS (dist/esm/*.js and dist/cjs/*.js) so tools that choke on .mjs/.cjs work; (b) make exports explicit with conditionals per-subpath, e.g. "./client": {"import":"./dist/esm/client.js","require":"./dist/cjs/client.js","types":"./dist/client.d.ts"}; (c) include typesVersions and add per-subpath types keys.

hana: Short-term workaround for starters: deep-import from dist: `import {createClient} from '@redwood/js-sdk/dist/esm/client.js'` and add an editor path mapping in tsconfig paths for the starter so the editor resolves types. We'll document it in the starter README.

amar: CI note: examples smoke test failed on preview. CI flagged resolver mismatch.

pete: Long-term: add release-time integration checks that run Node resolver, esbuild, and a Cloudflare/Pages local build (or run `wrangler pages dev`) against the examples to catch this class of breakage. Also add a lint in the release workflow that prevents adding bare .mjs/.cjs only exports without .js fallbacks.

hana: I'll open a hotfix PR to revert to the previous explicit map and add the .js artifacts as part of the build. Also adding issue #4602 to formalize export map guidance and CI checks.

pete: Thanks. Once hotfix published we should update docs with an "Export map guidelines" checklist: explicit subpaths, per-export types, .js fallbacks, avoid wildcards, include ./package.json export when helpful.

amar: Agreed. Locking the release until CI smoke passes.

hana: Posting the PR link here when ready and will ping #general after the patch is published. :thumbsup:
